title: NRP1 promotes hepatic fibrosis by regulating Src/Rab7-mediated lysosomal degradation of TβRI
task: Elucidate NRP1 regulation of TGF-β receptor stability via Src/Rab7-mediated lysosomal degradation in hepatic stellate cells
key_results: NRP1 promotes HSC activation and hepatic fibrosis by suppressing Src/Rab7-dependent lysosomal degradation of TβRI, thereby sustaining TGF-β signaling
comments: The study identifies a novel mechanism linking NRP1 to fibrosis progression, positioning the NRP1/Src/Rab7 axis as a potential therapeutic target, though functional validation and in vivo confirmation appear to be the next steps.

hypotheses.hypothesis: NRP1 acts as a co-receptor to stabilize TβRI and enhance TGF-β signaling in HSCs
hypotheses.result: NRP1 suppresses Src/Rab7-mediated TβRI degradation, promoting sustained fibrotic signaling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Src kinase and Rab7 GTPase regulate TβRI trafficking to lysosomes
hypotheses.result: Src/Rab7 axis controls TβRI lysosomal degradation, with NRP1 negatively regulating this pathway

title: Determinants of pregnancy termination among ever-married women of reproductive age in Bangladesh
task: Predicting pregnancy termination risk factors among reproductive-age women
key_results: Random Forest achieved 66.2% accuracy, 71.8% AUC; identified five key predictors: number of children, employment status, age at first sex, recent birth history, and respondent age
comments: Moderate predictive performance (AUC 71.8%) suggests substantial room for improvement; class imbalance (pregnancy termination prevalence not explicitly stated) may limit clinical utility.

model_io.model: Random Forest, XGBoost, KNN, SVM, ANN

hypotheses.hypothesis: Number of children, employment, and age variables predict pregnancy termination
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via RF feature importance; all five identified factors showed significance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Random Forest outperforms alternative ML models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RF showed highest accuracy (66.2%), specificity (67.8%), precision (40.0%), and AUC (71.8%)
